text:
maria: Heads-up: starting canary for 2026-03-22 change window in 10m. Patch v2.14.1. Reviewing backout/runbook links—can someone confirm quick? runbook: https://go/runbooks/unwind-v2 rollback: https://go/playbooks/rollback-v2

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service-ml @canary-group - 20% traffic - ID #db-24691

jamie: linked runbook looks stale — step 3 references old alert name. I'll update in 2m.

oliver: I'll be on-call for rollback if needed. Which metrics to watch? latency, 5xx, token-drop. set threshold: latency > 200ms p95 OR 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m -> rollback.

sara: Agree. Added thresholds to runbook (PR: https://go/changes/12345). Also adding a quick unpin command: `infra unpin service-ml --version v2.14.0`

maria: Thanks. ops_lead do you want auto-fallback to pinned version or hard rollback?

ops_lead: Prefer auto-fallback to pinned version with manual unpin for hotfix. Enable route-fallback policy 'pin-first' for this window. I'll watch the dashboard.

jamie: Canary reached 20%, no errors yet. Telemetry: p95 138ms, 5xx 0.03%

deploy-bot: Canary step succeeded, promoting to 50% in 5m unless abort.

oliver: If p95 jumps > 220ms at 50% revert immediately. I'll coordinate with infra.

maria: Tagging SRE oncall @oliver and @sara. If abort, use escape hatch: `deploy-bot abort db-24691 --reason "latency spike"`

sara: :thumbsup: noted. Also adding trace id retention note in runbook.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% complete. Canary ID db-24691. Logs: https://go/logs/db-24691

jamie: At 50% now — small blip in error budget alert (one spike), but it recovered. Keeping eyes.

maria: Plan: if alert fires twice in 10m, we execute backout per runbook steps 4-7. Manual unpin to follow if partial rollback needed.

ops_lead: :eyes: I'll escalate to Product if we need hotfix. Otherwise normal rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion complete. Final status: healthy.
